mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month indicates economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a decline in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of the instances when RSAFS drops > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO rises > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 45% of the instances when PAYEMS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST drops > 5% MoM and UNRATE rises > 0.2% MoM
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of the instances when HOUST drops > 5% MoM and UNRATE rises > 0.2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with an increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS drops > 0.25% and GDPC1 rises > 0.5% QoQ
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 45% of the instances when FEDFUNDS drops > 0.25% and GDPC1 rises > 0.5% QoQ.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) during a period of low inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a healthy supply-side expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 1% MoM and CPIAUCSL < 2% YoY
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO rises > 1% MoM and CPIAUCSL < 2% YoY.
